summary: Verifier is requirement-complete and behavior-oriented. Twenty-eight F2P and four P2P probes exercise revision/idempotency authority, canonical validation, quorum rollout, TCP streaming, PROXY inspection, readiness, eligibility, checkpoint padding, restart recovery, and corrupt CURRENT fallback. Docker oracle 32/32 and starter 10 F2P failures demonstrate strong discrimination without embedding a callable solver.

evidence.observation: 32 behavioral probes with live stack fixtures; no source-layout assertions.
Nine requirement groups mapped to 28 F2P and 4 P2P cases.
Binary reward via pytest exit code; verifier image extends agent env.

findings.why_it_matters: least_connections and passive ejection documented but not individually probed (aligned with Q4-A01/A03).

do_not_change: F2P behavioral coverage for authority, rollout, TCP, eligibility, and recovery invariants.
